title: 공군교육사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Commander)
(1) The Command shall have a Commander.
(2) The Commander shall be appointed by the President from among general officers of the Air Force on the recommendation of the Chief of Staff of the Air Force and upon the proposal of the Minister of National Defense. <Amended on September 5, 2017>
(3) The Commander shall, under orders from the Chief of Staff of the Air Force, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Command and command and supervise subordinate units (including those assigned to the Command).
(4) If the Commander is unable to perform duties, the senior officer among the heads of staff departments shall act on behalf of the Commander.
